descriptions: Fixed /relog not saving where the character was standing, so the character came back at the position of the last disconnect
Fixed the position being left entirely to the logout save of the core, which es_extended skips whenever xPlayer.spawned was never set
Fixed the heading being dropped from the saved position on qb-core
Fixed a character picked within a second of a relog being unloaded again by the ESX cleanup fallback, which left that player without any save until the next restart
